revisionHistory: Week of Model Trim(s) Comments / Description of Changes update: Atlas all: Atlas pricing & information released 32/26 Atlas Cross Sport all: Atlas Cross Sport information released - pricing pending 40/26 Golf GTI all: Golf GTI pricing & information released 43/26 Golf R all: Golf R pricing & information released 43/26 Jetta 1.5T all: Jetta 1.5T pricing & information released 32/26 Jetta GLI all: Jetta GLI pricing & information released 32/26 Taos all: Wheel offerings clarified 34/26 Taos all: Taos pricing & information released 32/26 Tiguan all: Tiguan pricing & information released 40/26
sourceTitle: Volkswagen MY27 Retail Price and Order Guide — CW43-2026
dateBasis: Cover footer revision date 9/28/26; release identified as 2026 week 43. Individual model pages retain their own footer dates; no publication date inferred from PDF metadata.

items.text: Volkswagen identifies the 2027 Atlas as ALL NEW. Output changes from 269 hp / 273 lb-ft to 282 hp / 258 lb-ft; the higher horsepower is accompanied by lower quoted torque.
The listed lineup is now SE, SE w/ Technology, SEL R-Line® and SEL Premium R-Line®. Atlas Peak Edition and the plain SEL name from 2026 are not listed in this edition.
The standard 12-inch center display is replaced by a 12.9-inch display on SE and a 15-inch display on SE w/ Technology and above. Dual front Qi chargers replace the single front charger.

SEL R-Line® and SEL Premium R-Line® add active ventilation for outboard second-row seats; 2026 documented rear heating without ventilation. New Varenna/Nappa upholstery choices, real wood décor and revised ambient lighting are detailed by trim.
Front/rear Park Distance Control and hands-free Easy Open/Easy Close are now standard even on SE; both were unavailable on 2026 SE.

Travel Assist adds assisted lane changing and Emergency Assist becomes Emergency Assist Plus. SEL Premium R-Line® adds Park Assist Plus with Memory Parking; the new seven-airbag protection system is documented across trims.
The SE w/ Technology Black Wheel Package changes from 20-inch 40T wheels to 54U wheels; the 2027 package carries limited availability ending CW02/27.

gaps: Volkswagen labels the model ALL NEW; the order guide does not establish new exterior/interior measurements or fuel economy. The p. 5 photo caption still mentions Atlas Peak Edition, although that trim is absent from the configuration and equipment tables. Confirm any later trim release separately.

items.text: Volkswagen identifies the 2027 Atlas Cross Sport as ALL NEW. Output changes from 269 hp / 273 lb-ft to 282 hp / 258 lb-ft.
SE and SE w/ Technology retain FWD/AWD listings, followed by AWD SEL R-Line® and SEL Premium R-Line®. The 2026 plain SEL and SEL R-Line® Black names are no longer listed.
The 12-inch center display is replaced by 12.9 inches on SE and 15 inches on higher trims. Dual front Qi chargers replace the single front charger.

SEL R-Line® and SEL Premium R-Line® now document heated and actively ventilated outboard rear seats, plus Varenna/Nappa upholstery and revised interior lighting. The 2026 table documented rear heating without ventilation.

SE gains standard front/rear Park Distance Control and hands-free Easy Open/Easy Close, previously unavailable on SE. Assisted lane changing, Emergency Assist Plus and a seven-airbag system are documented; SEL Premium R-Line® adds Memory Parking.

gaps: All retail, destination, paint and package prices remain TBA in this edition. New measurements, fuel economy and detailed redesign specifications need the 2027 technical guide.

items.text: SE R-Line® Black gains a standard heated steering wheel; the 2026 equipment matrix marked it not offered on that trim. The 2027 production credit 2PD can remove steering-wheel heating, so verify the actual window sticker.
The driver-assistance table now names Emergency Assist Plus instead of Emergency Assist.

gaps: The PJ2 wheel package still has conflicting wheel codes: U24 on p. 13 versus 48H on p. 16. Confirm the correct code with Volkswagen. Detailed 2027 fuel economy and measurements are not supplied; 2026 technical values have not been copied.

items.text: A new Sport trim is listed in FWD and 4MOTION AWD, between S and SE. Its equipment includes GOAL-pattern cloth with yellow contrast stitching, black exterior accents and drivetrain-specific black wheels.
S gains standard MIB3 Composition Media and a six-speaker sound system. The 2026 S listing used Composition Color and did not offer the six-speaker system.

gaps: The SE FWD P35 wheel option from 2026 is not listed in the 2027 factory option table; absence from this non-exhaustive guide is not confirmation of discontinuation. Technical measurements, fuel economy and a tow rating require additional documentation.

items.text: Travel Assist now documents assisted lane changing across S, SE and Autobahn; the 2026 table described Travel Assist without assisted lane changing.
Emergency Assist Plus replaces the previously named Emergency Assist in the standard IQ.DRIVE equipment listing.

gaps: No other major equipment redesign or powertrain change is established by these two editions. 2027 EPA economy, measurements and any broader launch changes need technical/release documentation.

items.text: Golf R Black Edition is newly listed beside Golf R. Its documented standard distinctions include gloss-black 19-inch wheels, black badging/logos and black exhaust tips.

Akrapovič titanium exhaust is now a standalone factory option 0P8 for either trim. The 2026 guide bundled it in Euro Style Package POA. The POA roof/ventilation deletion package is not listed in this edition; do not label the retained standard roof and ventilated seats as newly added equipment.
Travel Assist adds assisted lane changing and the standard suite names Emergency Assist Plus instead of Emergency Assist.

gaps: The guide does not expressly confirm discontinuation of Euro Style Package POA; its absence is a listing change. Detailed 2027 fuel economy and technical measurements remain unresolved.

items.text: Push-button engine start is now standard on S and Sport as well as SE and SEL; the 2026 table marked S and Sport not offered.
S and Sport now receive MIB3 Composition Media instead of Composition Color. SE and SEL retain their documented systems rather than being labeled new.
The 2027 guide explicitly marks the front/rear seatbelt reminder system NEW and standard on every trim; it was not listed in the reviewed 2026 equipment table.

gaps: Unlisted 2026 seatbelt-reminder equipment is not treated as proven absence; this change follows the explicit 2027 NEW label. Technical measurements and 2027 fuel economy require additional documentation.
The p. 35 JDD Dynamic Center Caps retail amount is printed as $22, while comparable entries elsewhere in the guide are $228. The $22 source value is retained; manufacturer confirmation is needed.

items.text: The 2027 configuration table lists Autobahn with seven-speed DSG only; the 2026 table listed both six-speed manual and DSG. Do not carry the manual configuration into 2027 from the previous year.
The front/rear seatbelt reminder system is explicitly marked NEW and standard in the 2027 guide. No 2026 absence is inferred from its omission in that table.

gaps: The p. 38 illustration caption still says manual although the priced table lists only DSG. Manual availability requires Volkswagen clarification; the caption is not used to invent a configuration. The 2026 projector-headlamp description is absent from the 2027 table, so removal is not claimed. Fuel economy and technical measurements require the 2027 specifications.

sourceConflicts.resolution: Both source statements retained separately; manufacturer clarification needed. No wheel code guessed.

exceptions.feature: Steering Credit Issued – Steering wheel lacks heating function
exceptions.resolution: Production credit retained as a source restriction, not an orderable option.
